thread:
sam: Intro thread for AtriaCare POC — they want to validate two main flows: (1) clinical note summarization (streaming chat) and (2) semantic search over proprietary docs (embeddings + rerank). Need to lock success criteria and integration checklist.

neha: Suggested success criteria: chat p95 latency < 350ms at 256 tokens; semantic search MRR@5 > 0.6 on our seed queries; end-to-end pipeline (ingest -> embed -> search -> rerank) end-to-end 2s median. Also set qualitative goal: <5% hallucination rate on clinical summaries.

owen: Integration checklist:
- SDKs: recommend python client (redwood==2.1.0) + JS for frontend streaming prototypes.
- Auth: for POC use API keys; include request_id header for idempotency. Long-term: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning.
- Telemetry: enable per-route tracing, token-level cost logs (we'll share sample dashboard).
- Rate limits: default 60 rps per key; can request temporary bump to 200 rps for load-testing windows.
- Streaming: use chunked transfer or SSE; fallback to polling for strict firewall environments.
- Retries: client-side jittered exp backoff (base 300ms, factor 2, max attempts 4).
- Data controls: IP allowlist + KMS-wrapped customer keys for encryption at rest.

sam: Procurement asked about an SOC2 artifact and vendor questionnaire. Do we have the latest pack?

legal-bot: uploaded: https://redwood.internal/security/soc2-latest.pdf and auto-responses to the vendor questionnaire (redwood-vendor-qna-2025.docx).

neha: For evals we should collect 100 positive and 50 adversarial prompts from AtriaCare SMEs. We'll run pairwise human labeling for 200 items (cost estimated). Timeline: prompt collection 5 business days, initial runs 3 days, iterate 4 days — total ~12 business days.

owen: Pricing Qs: they want a hard monthly spend cap and a test pool for internal users with reduced quotas. Sales: can we offer a 3-week trial with spend cap $5k and the option to convert to committed Dedicated credits?

sam: Will align with sales. Also need to set up a sandbox project in us-west region and share API key with their integration lead.

deploy-bot: created: sandbox project atriacare-poc-usw, api key redacted, logs enabled.

neha: Next action items:
- Owen: share sample prompt JSON + small Python harness for streaming and embedding tests by EOD PT.
- Sam: send SOW draft and spend cap proposal to the AEs.
- Legal-bot: attach vendor Q&A link in the thread.

sam: Thanks all — sync scheduled Fri 10am PT to review prompt set and runbook.
